2608.12776.title: ViTOED: A Dataset for Target-Oriented Emotion Detection on Vietnamese Social Media Texts
2608.12776.paper_summary: This paper introduces ViTOED, a novel dataset for target-oriented emotion detection in Vietnamese social media texts. The ViTOED comprises 10,985 user comments and 21,244 manually annotated opinion quadruples (source, target, expression, polarity) that follow strict guidelines. The dataset reveals Vietnamese-specific phenomena, such as implicit sources and targets and vocabulary ambiguities, enabling deeper analysis of user emotions toward entities. We propose a baseline using structured sentiment graphs and evaluate various Vietnamese pre-trained language models. The empirical results highlight challenges in span detection and relation extraction and indicate substantial room for model improvement in Vietnamese Target-Oriented Emotion Detection tasks.
2608.12776.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文介紹了 ViTOED，一個用於越南社交媒體文本中目標導向情感檢測的新數據集。ViTOED 包含 10,985 條用戶評論和 21,244 條手動標註的意見四元組（來源、目標、表達、極性），這些都遵循嚴格的指導方針。該數據集揭示了越南特有的現象，例如隱含的來源和目標以及詞彙的歧義，使得對用戶情感對實體的深入分析成為可能。我們提出了一個基準，使用結構化情感圖，並評估各種越南預訓練語言模型。實證結果突顯了範圍檢測和關係提取中的挑戰，並表明在越南目標導向情感檢測任務中模型改進的潛力相當大。
